notes: - **Fixed stock charts showing "ENOENT: no such file or directory … server/engine.js" on a fresh install.** The chart HTML was assembled by reading three browser-side files (engine/indicators/talib-ext) from disk at runtime, but those files are never `require()`d — so a plugin loader that installs only the required module graph placed the bundled `index.js` without them, breaking every chart. Those client files are now **embedded into the bundle at build time** (via `client-embed`), so the shipped server assembles charts with **zero runtime file reads** and no sibling-file dependency.
